prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-human-council.png. Requested dimensions 1024x1024, 1:1. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
1 · Human — homeworld Sol — accent steel-blue
Game role: the diplomats and traders; the "friendly" default. Strengths: expert traders (trade treaties pay more), magnificent diplomats (everyone starts friendly, Council votes count extra), cheap force-field science. Weakness: no martial, production, growth or spy edge — they win by deals and shields.
Body & dress: ordinary human variety; the approved leader is a weathered 50-something admiral-diplomat. Deep navy naval-style uniform, silver braid, discreet insignia; civilian formal wear for audiences (dark tailored coats, a small comm-pin). Never overtly militaristic.
Surroundings: an orbital capital: warm-lit wood-and-steel offices, trade-hall mezzanines, big windows onto Earth-blue planetlight, commodity tickers, ship models, treaty tables with brass fittings. Pragmatic, comfortable, a little worn.
Personality: charming, shrewd, amused, quietly tough. Moods: warm-genial → polite-wary → cold-courteous.
Hooks: a diplomat's pouch of gifts, mismatched souvenirs from many alien courts, a chess-like board game left mid-play.
Asset purpose: Seated Galactic Council delegate portrait. EXACT SAME leader individual, anatomy, face and uniform identity as reference. Seated in race-specific alcove within a dim domed Galactic Council chamber, ceremonial sash or chain of office consistent with species, hands resting or holding an unmarked ballot token. Controlled pool of race accent light.

Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
